title: CAx
html:
定义组：经典命题。有序参数：t。

精确含义以本页公式体及其全部依赖为准。

规范公式

    (exists a

        (and
          (@ FmC a)
          (and
            (@ FmC b)
            (exists z253

                        (and (exists z258 (and (= z258 b) (@ Node1a1 z258 z256))) (@ Node2a2 z255 z256 z253)))))
                  (and
                    (exists z259 (exists z260 (and (= z259 b) (and (= z260 a) (@ Node2a2 z259 z260 z254)))))
